profile_text.body:
IBM is a publicly traded technology company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY. It reported revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, and trades on public markets under the ticker IBM with SEC CIK 0000051143. The company's site focuses on its governance, risk, and compliance offerings, describing IBM OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered GRC platform that helps organizations manage risk, compliance, and audit functions in one integrated solution, available on any cloud or on-premises with a modular architecture.

IBM's tracked AI products span two primary categories. IBM OpenPages with Watson is described as a full GRC platform incorporating AI-specific modules, risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation. The site notes that OpenPages can integrate watsonx.ai or third-party AI models through an API-based architecture, and that an OpenPages MCP Server is offered to enable AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects within agent frameworks. IBM watsonx.governance covers AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, and includes EU AI Act accelerators; it was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. IBM watsonx is described more broadly as an enterprise AI platform that is model-agnostic and incorporates agent inventory management, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. The site also states that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and cites Citi as a partner that used IBM's AI and machine learning to automate its internal audit process.

The held facts record no litigation or MCP server registry entries for IBM beyond what the company's own site describes regarding the OpenPages MCP Server.
